Title: Mata Hari and Guhuri are the Land

Messages.Author: Jeff Kuta
Messages.Body:
Mata Hari equips with the Eye of Hazimel. Clearly she can use Guhuri
are the Land to untap.

Mata Hari equips with a Treasured Samadji (and Weirding Stone and
Living Manse, and...and...). Can she also play Guhuri are the land to
untap, or is she considered acting "as a Ravnos/Tzimisce/etc" so
prohibited from modifying her action as another clan?

TIV.

Jeff

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:
Jeff Kuta wrote:
> Mata Hari equips with the Eye of Hazimel. Clearly she can use Guhuri
> are the Land to untap.

True.

> Mata Hari equips with a Treasured Samadji (and Weirding Stone and
> Living Manse, and...and...). Can she also play Guhuri are the land to
> untap, or is she considered acting "as a Ravnos/Tzimisce/etc" so
> prohibited from modifying her action as another clan?

She can play GatL per her special, regardless of what she plays the action card as.
